title: Lindenring, Taufkirchen
description:
Bright & Fully Furnished Room with Garden Access – Ready to Move In 🌿
This spacious and fully furnished room is ready for immediate occupancy and offers a bright and comfortable living environment. Thanks to the large window front with direct garden access, the room is filled with natural light and creates a pleasant atmosphere. Curtains and blinds allow for full privacy and blackout when needed.

The apartment is well-equipped for shared living. The kitchen provides plenty of space to cook and spend time together and includes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, ceramic hob, and basic kitchen equipment. Additionally, a large built-in wardrobe in the hallway is shared among the flatmates, offering extra storage space. A private cellar compartment is also included.

📍 Location
The apartment is located in a quiet and green residential area. Shops, supermarkets, and all daily necessities are within walking distance. The S-Bahn station Taufkirchen is only about 700 meters away, providing excellent connections. With the S3, you can reach Munich city center in approximately 15 minutes.

🏠 Living Concept
We place great importance on creating a respectful and harmonious shared living environment. Our flatmates are carefully selected to ensure a clean, organized, and friendly atmosphere. The goal is to offer a home where you can both relax and enjoy a sense of community.

title: Lindenring, Taufkirchen
description:
Schönes WG-Zimmer in einer 4er WG. 

Das Zimmer ist komplett möbliert. Ein Bett, Nachttisch, Sessel, Regal, Schreibtisch mit Stuhl. Durch das große Fenster ist es angenehm hell im.  Zimmer. Das Fenster kann mit Vorhängen oder Jalousien abgedunkelt werden.

Im Flur befindet sich zudem ein großer Einbauschrank welcher unter den Bewohnern aufgeteilt werden kann. Die Küche sowie das Badezimmer mit Badewanne können von allen Mietern genutzt werden. Eine Waschmaschine, Geschirrspülmaschine und erste Küchenausstattung sind vorhanden. Zur Wohnung gehört ein Kellerabteil und ein Fahrradkeller.

Der Mietpreis beträgt 720.- € warm inkl. aller Nebenkosten und schnellem WLAN

Die Wohnung liegt in Taufkirchen. Direkt vor der Haustür befindet sich eine Bushaltestelle. Hier hält der Bus, welcher zur S-Bahn fährt. Fußläufig erreicht man die S-Bahn in ca. 8 Minuten und ist nach 20 Minuten in der Münchner Innenstadt. Mit dem Auto ist man in ca. 15 Minuten in München.
Alle Geschäfte des täglichen Bedarfs sind in der Nähe angesiedelt.
Die Wohnung liegt in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in einem grünen, ruhigen Viertel.



Nice room in a shared flat. 

The room is fully furnished. A bed, bedside table, armchair, shelf, desk with chair. The large window makes the room pleasantly bright. The window can be darkened with curtains or blinds.

In the hallway there is also a large built-in wardrobe which can be divided among the residents. The kitchen and the bathroom with a bathtub can be used by all tenants. A washing machine, dishwasher and basic kitchen equipment are available. A cellar compartment and a bicycle storage room belong to the apartment.

The rent is €720 including all utilities and fast Wi-Fi.

The apartment is located in Taufkirchen. There is a bus stop right on the doorstep. The bus that goes to the S-Bahn stops here. The S-Bahn can be reached in about 8 minutes on foot and you can be in the centre of Munich in 20 minutes. It takes about 15 minutes to get to Munich by car.
All shops for daily needs are nearby.
The apartment is located in an apartment building in a green, quiet neighbourhood.

title: Rathausstraße, Taufkirchen
description:
Relax in this peaceful accommodation.
The apartment has 55 m2 and is located in Taufkirchen near Munich, right next to the town hall.
Taufkirchen S-Bahn station can be reached in 15 minutes on foot or 3 minutes by bus.
A Penny supermarket, a DHL branch, and the Sparkasse bank are just a 2-minute walk away.
There is a sofa bed for 2 people.
